answer_1.quote: We redefine the Chinese Spelling Correction (CSC) task to require the model to output the positions of incorrect characters along with their corrections.
answer_1.outputs: The model outputs JSON structures with position, incorrect character, and correction, or corrected text sequences.

answer_2.quote: We introduce several metrics... Position Prediction Accuracy (PPA)... Sentence-Level Accuracy (SA)... Precision (CP)... Recall (CR)... F1 Score (CF1)...
